text:
nina: Heads-up: product asked for a per-tenant SLO notify "quiet" flow so we can reduce noise for heavy-but-low-value tenants. sketching console + api behavior here.

omar: Important we keep observability tight. If we suppress alerts we still need to surface a "suppressed events" timeline in SLO card so oncall can inspect.

tess: Console idea: in the SLO card add a compact "Override" panel. Options: preview-only (no effect), soft (reduce fanout + lower notify_threshold), force (force specific routing). Show estimate: alerts/day and monthly cost delta.

keith: Backend constraints: overrides must be auditable and traceable. Log `slo.override.decide` with fields tenant, override_id, actor, and decision_reason. Keep traces for 14 days.

samir: Minimal API payload: {"tenant":"T-42","override_id":"ov-2024-07","mode":"soft","notify_threshold":0.9,"route_action":"prefer_cached","expires":"2024-08-01T00:00:00Z"}. We'll publish proto later.

nina: UX: make preview default. Users should be able to "simulate" override impact across last 7/30/90 days. Also let ops configure sampling of raw request/response pairs for quality audit (default 0.1%).

omar: telemetry needs: `slo.notify.expected_alerts` (model estimate), `slo.notify.actual_alerts`, `slo.override.applied` (count), `routing.override.reason`. Tag with override_id and preview=true/false.

tess: Estimation model: use recent alerts/week, current error_budget_burn_rate, and quota burn velocity. Show CI and a small risk meter.

keith: Safety rules: if after applying an override we see `slo.quality.delta` > 0.04 for 30m => auto-rollback + page oncall. Also emit `slo.override.rolled_back` event with revert_cause and actor=system.

samir: Implementation note: pipeline should check override.apply_mode; for `soft` apply internal fanout multiplier (e.g., 0.5) and reduce non-critical channels. `force` should bypass fanout rules and route to the specified variant.

nina: Rollout: start with internal orgs + 5 alpha customers. Add a canary mode in which override is preview-only for 2k tenants to validate estimates.

omar: Security: only ops and tenant admins can enable force overrides. All override create/update/delete actions must write to audit log with SSO identity.

tess: Console: show a history timeline: created_by, previewed_by, applied_at, rolled_back_at. Also offer a quick link to sampled responses (pre/post) for manual QA.

keith: Add a nightly job: mark overrides older than 30d as stale and surface a banner on tenant page. Also add an admin bulk-expire job.

samir: Pseudocode enforcement hook: if override and not expired: if mode=="soft": reduce_fanout(); if mode=="force": force_route(); record metric `slo.override.applied`.

audit-bot: audit-bot: created ticket PLAT-5117 to track API + console work and scheduled staging canary 2024-07-18 (job-id: staging-1213).

nina: OK I'll draft RFC with API proto, console mocks, and telemetry table. followups: - ensure sampling rate is configurable per-tenant and capped org-wide, - add sample retention notes, - define CI threshold for estimation accuracy.

(tl;dr) Provide tenant-scoped SLO notify overrides (preview/soft/force), console preview with estimates and sampling, strict audit logs and telemetry tags, automatic rollback on quality regression, and a conservative staged rollout.
